title: Scottish
summary: SCOT'TISH, adjective Pertaining to the inhabitants of Scotland, or to their country or language; as scottish industry or economy; a Scotish chief; the scottish dialect.

inlines.v: SCOT'TISH, adjective Pertaining to the inhabitants of Scotland, or to their country or language; as scottish industry or economy; a Scotish chief; the scottish dialect.
